notes.title: Heatwave Update Now Live! 35+ New Songs, Free Weekend & 50% Off
notes.content:
One year ago, Electronauts brought the high-vibe energy of electronic remixing to VR, and quickly became one of the medium's most innovative, critically-acclaimed music experiences. Today, we welcome you BACK to the jam with the Heatwave Update, now LIVE!

Featuring 35+ fresh new jams—including tracks from Childish Gambino,  Giraffage, JMSN, Kygo, and TOKiMONSTA—the Heatwave Update will help you  chill out in these dog days of summer. Here's the full artist lineup (and for those of you keeping score, Electronauts now has a total of 80+ songs from over 80 artists!):

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31461134/2cde19627bcbe3742eb71ab04a044e19a88fea39.jpg

We're celebrating this brand-new content update with an Electronauts Steam Free Weekend, starting NOW through Sunday, August 18, at 11:59pm PDT! Plus, pick up Electronauts for 50% off on Steam during the Free Weekend!

notes.title: Jam with Monstercat in the First Electronauts Content Update, Now Live!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31461134/939fe0715c411e0bee85f2a8b79a652d41b1e62d.png

From the EDM masterminds behind the pulsing Rocket League soundtrack comes Electronauts’ first awesome new song expansion pack: the Monstercat update! Jam out now with four free tracks from their acclaimed catalog:

Bad Computer - "Disarray"
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ak6ynwcCv1Q
Haywyre - "Memory"
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i82fsHN5CPs
Snails & Pegboard Nerds - "Deep in the Night"
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a5FkPFzyKs0
Droptek - "Inject"
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dMZNdBdheqQ
Plus, Monstercat is looking to see what you can make with their music! Share and tag your freshest Monstercat remixes on Survios' social channels (Twitter and Instagram) for a chance to be featured on Survios’ social channels.

Finally, Electronauts v1.1 patches some issues helpfully reported to us from launch, so enjoy these fixes and get back to beatmaking!

Patch Notes for Electronauts v1.1 (released September 4, 2018)

Monstercat Songs: Added four new songs by artists from the label Monstercat: "Disarray" by Bad Computer, "Memory" by Haywyre, "Deep in the Night" by Snails & Pegboard Nerds, and "Inject" by Droptek
Quick Match: Added player count info on Quick Match wait screen
Offline Mode: Fixed a bug that prevented players from playing in offline mode Steam/Oculus
FX Buttons: Fixed transition FX buttons not properly resetting their position after being pressed and switching decks
Tutorials: Fixed audio doubling up in tutorials
Arrangement Tool Save Data: Fixed an issue with the arrangement tool that caused save data to be erased after a patch
Arrangement Tool Reset: Fixed reset of arrangement tool if undocked during menu pop-up transition

notes.title: Welcome to the Jam: ELECTRONAUTS Now Available!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31461134/a0d151308cf85306785a8e7bfbf14e439cd0743a.png

Synth orbs: polished. Laser harp: tuned. Lava looper: bubbled.

Electronaut, you are clear for launch: welcome to the jam.

For the past week Electronauts has been lighting up the livestreams, and now it’s your turn: Electronauts is officially available right now at a special release discount of 10% off* (through August 21).

Ride the vibes of a top DJ playing a packed festival’s main stage, no musical experience necessary: all it takes to be an Electronaut is the passion to become one with the beat. And with over 40 songs from 50+ artists, you’re sure to find the music that moves you to explore, experiment, and electrify.

Survios personally worked with top electronic music artists to ensure that their tracks were treated faithfully, and it was a transformative experience for all involved. Check out our in-studio interview with Electronauts featured artist Krewella:

https://youtu.be/fjfGWMvFUTI
Ready to blast off into uncharted realms of creativity? Get acquainted with Electronauts’ interactive deck in the first installment of our how-to video series. GOODHENRY himself (a.k.a. lead audio engineer Henry) shows you the basics that’ll get you beatmaking in no time.

https://youtu.be/MlNVmiV-g2s
Finally, if you're looking ooking for inspiration, a co-op jamming partner, or just some awesome VR friends, the official Survios Discord is where you’ll find it, with over 2,000 members plus cool contests, creative prompts, and community challenges to stimulate your Electronauts journey.

Electronauts v1.0 Build Notes - August 7, 2018

New songs included: “Roses,” “I Like it Loud,” “Bergschrund,” and “Megastar”
Scrubbed config data to prevent data miners from seeing future songs in game
Multiplayer Voice chat delay fixed
Updated credits with special thanks and music credits 
Allowed Mac users to play against PC users via Quick Match
Fixed minor UI issues with menu selection
Added synth ball back into Klip
Adjusted player hands .03 units on Vive
Visualizer speed will save per song

Known Issues

Handheld Menu - Options - Pointer may become unresponsive when Options is held at certain angles.
Multiplayer - Host is able to record sequences without holding Trigger/Record



*Excluding EU customers.

notes.title: SIgn Up for the Electronauts Creator Beta & Lead the Future of Music Creation
notes.content:
Hey everyone--we are so stoked to finally reveal Survios' third and latest project, Electronauts!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31461134/a90587884776c48bad7d316be241e6b8c1a7f7b0.jpg

Electronauts plunges you into a surreal sonic experience where you can remix, compose, jam, and perform on uniquely designed electronic instruments--and all without needing any prior musical knowledge, skill, or experience. The innovative new Music Reality Engine™ keeps your music bumpin' on the beat so you always sound great, so give yourself over to the rhythm, change the scheme, alter the mood, and electrify your virtual world! 

Additionally, we've teamed up with Grammy award-winning superproducer duo Stargate to enlist the talent of top artists and DJs to populate Electronauts' expansive library with sounds, tracks, loops, stems...any musical vibe you could possibly want.

To get up-to-date news and first looks, follow Electronauts on social media:

Twitter
Facebook
Instagram
SoundCloud

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31461134/6d31d1091fe83f4877da3186d4c0d6539a53c021.jpg

Ambitious artists can get in on the action early with the Electronauts Creator Beta, a closed beta for creators who want to compose music with Electronauts and/or be integrated into the final version of Electronauts! If you can't wait to start building your own immersive sonic world, sign up now at www.electronautsvr.com.

Signing off,
The Electronauts Dev Team
